parsed.text: This packet contains two panels (p0, p1) of fallible 4×4 location distributions for red and blue at nodes n0–n3. Copied prior records in the packet are not new estimates; conditional command candidate records (k0,k1,k2) are conditional estimates, not executed events. Panel p0 current estimates: n0 — blue peak at (0,1), red at (0,3); n1 and n2 — uniform; n3 — both blue and red peak at (1,2) in the current view. In p0 candidate records n3 varies: k0 raises blue peak probability and slightly raises red there; k2 raises blue and shifts red peak to (0,1). Panel p1 current is uniform at n3; p1 candidates alter n3 differently: k0 concentrates blue mass in the top-right 2×2 and red in the top-left 2×2, k1 leaves n3 near-uniform, and k2 concentrates blue at (1,2) and red at (0,1). No physical presence or occurrence claims are made; these numbers describe only the supplied distributions.
